name: Harbin Electric Corporation Jiamusi Electric Machine CO.,Ltd
summary: Harbin Electric Corporation Jiamusi Electric Machine CO.,Ltd manufactures and sells electric motors in the People's Republic of China. It operates through Nuclear Power Products, Electric Motors, and Services segments. The company offers ordinary motors, explosion-proof motors, and nuclear power products. It also exports its products. The company was formerly known as Acheng Relay Co., Ltd. and changed its name to Harbin Electric Corporation Jiamusi Electric Machine CO.,Ltd in September 2012. Harbin Electric Corporation Jiamusi Electric Machine CO.,Ltd was founded in 1993 and is based in Jiamusi, the People's Republic of China.
